paragraphs.text: Patrick "Trick" R. Jarrett (born in 1983 in Atlanta, GA) is a former editor for Magic: The Gathering at Wizards of the Coast .
Jarrett matriculated to Georgia Tech, where he was a Computer Science major until he dropped out in 2006.

Wizards of the Coast hired Jarrett in December 2011 as a content manager overseeing articles on DailyMTG.com . By mid-2014, he had been promoted past editor-in-chief, and as of June 2020 held the title of Senior Content Strategist.
In 2023, Jarrett was part of the design team for the Doctor Who set.
On November 10, 2025, Jarret announced that the next day would be his last at Wizards, to become Editor-in-Chief for Riftbound at Riot Games.
